rationale: C12 plausibly supplied a material drafting template. Both memoranda reject special federal legislation for a locally significant project, warn that approval would create an undesirable precedent encouraging similar federal measures, characterize the matter as more appropriately handled by state or local authorities, and conclude by proposing that state-level action proceed instead. C11 is also structurally close because it rejects creation or continued operation of an unnecessary federal “facility,” but its administrative and fiscal rationale is less aligned. C25 shares the park context and a precedent-based objection to piecemeal legislation, but not the child’s fuller federal-versus-local sequence.

shared_material.child_excerpt: This legislation would establish an undesirable precedent... might well lead to further efforts to establish other outlying areas as “facilities” of individual parks and monuments
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I indicated that I would not be inclined to approve the creation of bridge commissions of the type contemplated by that bill in the absence of special emergency circumstances... [the bills would create] additional bridge commissions.
shared_material.explanation: Both make replication of an exceptional federal arrangement a central reason for disapproval.

shared_material.child_excerpt: there is considerable local historical interest in this area and it may well be the subject of State or local action for its preservation. This solution would seem to be in the best public interest.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The construction and operation of interstate bridges... has traditionally been a State rather than a Federal responsibility... I, therefore, suggest that if the States of Indiana and Kentucky determine that these two bridges are needed, they enter into appropriate agreements to proceed
shared_material.explanation: Both redirect a project of chiefly local or regional concern from special federal legislation to state or local action.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I find no sound basis for the acquisition and recognition of an indecisive feature of the campaign as a facility of the park.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am unaware of any circumstances which would make the provision of bridges at Lawrenceburg and Cannelton so urgent as to justify special Federal legislation
shared_material.explanation: Each finds the particular project insufficiently important or exceptional to justify the proposed special federal mechanism.
